Hello root — I'm Hana, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. What I can do, in one line each:
- Web app: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit takes the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, and my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Tell me if you want that.
- I can create my own accounts on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.
Two things are not set yet: my name and my gender (I use neuter forms meanwhile). Tell me which and I'll set them.
